visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a bright Carrefour supermarket, a man with short dark hair in a black long-sleeved shirt and shorts pushes a yellow shopping trolley. Beside him, a woman in a black t-shirt, jeans, and a white mask walks along. They are in the aisle with promotional banners overhead. (2) The camera switches to a close-up of the man talking, then back to the woman who is now wearing round sunglasses. They continue their conversation while walking past shelves stocked with household goods and food items. (3) A female fan with long hair and glasses approaches them, looking surprised. The man quickly puts on sunglasses and poses, seemingly trying to hide his identity or play along with a joke. The setting remains the crowded supermarket aisle with varied product displays. (4) The man is shown in a close-up with a digital overlay of blue tears falling from his eyes while he looks mournfully at the camera. The background shows blurred supermarket shelves. (5) A fast-paced montage follows, showing the man excitedly pointing at and holding various BBQ items: raw beef, pork, vegetables in plastic wrap, and bottles of sauce. He gestures wildly with his hands to emphasize the variety. (6) A man wearing a black mask holds up a smartphone showing the Openpoint app interface. The scene cuts to a finger pressing buttons on a self-checkout kiosk screen, demonstrating the points redemption process. (7) A woman in a white lace dress stands in front of a trolley, speaking directly to the camera with high energy. She is surrounded by BBQ grills and charcoal bags in a dedicated festival section of the store. (8) A group of six people sit at long tables outdoors on a patio during the day. They are holding up drinks, eating skewers, and laughing. Several plates of grilled food and bottles of Coca-Cola are on the table. (9) The screen transitions to a clean white background featuring the blue and red Carrefour logo and the store's name in Chinese characters.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, energetic acoustic guitar music with a bright synth lead starts. A male voice sings a short melodic intro jingle. Conversation between a man and woman begins at moderate conversational speed with friendly, casual tones. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect marks a transition. A new female voice enters, speaking with polite excitement. The male speaker replies with a humorous, slightly exaggerated defensive tone as if performing a skit. (3) A loud cartoonish 'wailing' crying sound effect triggers, lasting about 2 seconds, followed by a brief strategic silence. (4) The music tempo remains consistent but the male narration becomes rapid-fire and high-arousal. Frequent 'whoosh' and 'click' sound effects occur every 2-3 seconds to highlight specific product features. (5) A different male voice with a clear, professional broadcast quality introduces app features. Digital UI 'beep' sound effects are audible in the background to simulate app interaction. (6) A final female voice speaks with very high energy and a rising pitch, delivering promotional details. Multiple voices are heard laughing and cheering together as the background music builds to a peak before fading out with a final melodic brand jingle.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear -> Montage -> List-based: Narrative Hook -> Fan Interaction Skit -> Product Range Showcase -> Technical App Benefit -> Festive Community CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video utilizes a comedy skit featuring popular creator Ba Xuan to grab attention before transitioning into a comprehensive promotional showcase for Carrefour's Mid-Autumn Festival offerings. It highlights a vast range of BBQ equipment and food ingredients while specifically promoting the integration of the Openpoint reward system to encourage consumer spending and loyalty.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct interaction with store staff, explicit naming of the brand 'Carrefour', and detailed explanation of the 'Openpoint' reward program.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly polished commercial designed for social media, blending creator-led entertainment with direct retail information to drive holiday consumption.
